stem: If xy = 1 and x is greater than 0, which of the following statements is true?

options.label: A
options.text: When x is greater than 1, y is negative.

options.label: B
options.text: When x is greater than 1, y is greater than 1.

options.label: C
options.text: When x is less than 1, y is less than 1.
